caption:
Stock market news | Uber appoints Rakesh Ranjan as India head from January 4

Uber announced the appointment of Rakesh Ranjan, previously Zomato's food-delivery chief, as its president for India and South Asia. The move was reported on 26 November 2026.\nRanjan joins Uber after leading Zomato Gold, sales and serving as CEO of Allen Online, bringing extensive food-delivery and tech experience to Uber's Indian operations.
